generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen edit with edit-target as Image 1 and style canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: Thirty-six-bin axial land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean; water and its four immediate neighbours are excluded, as are gradients below twelve luminance units.
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No coherent cast-shadow field is obvious, but basalt top caps are consistently lighter than their vertical faces and several recessed faces are darker. The literal equal-value-on-every-side requirement is not met.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Manual visual estimate as fractions of non-water terrain at native source resolution.
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad quarry-floor and plateau tops count as buildable; exposed column faces and fall walls count as steep; talus, shingle, broken rims, scrub, and conifers make up the remainder.

crown.method: Manual full-silhouette width census at native 1254 px of all 27 discernible conifer crowns, including saplings, overlaps, and frame-clipped crowns; median native width 33 px was scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 4.8 cm/px.

waterMask.encoding: Opaque white water on fully transparent non-water; binary alpha.
waterMask.componentInterpretation: The largest component is the sea and connected lower outlet; the four smaller components are separated reaches of the descending watercourse where dry basalt rims divide painted water surfaces.
waterMask.method: Trace all cool chromatic water, close pinholes, grow adjacent neutral foam and reflections without crossing warm basalt, fill only small enclosed texture holes, and verify the native-resolution red overlay includes surf, wash, stream reaches, fall, and plunge foam.

west.requiredFromNorth: sea, ground, watercourse, ground, sea in the exact supplied proportions

refusalReasons: The west edge is terrain for its first 1145 of 1254 pixels and water only for the final 109 pixels; it does not match the required sea-ground-watercourse-ground-sea delivery pattern.
The north edge contains 502 terrain pixels although it must be entirely sea.
The generated mainland extends across almost half the canvas instead of ending 15-40 metres inside the required short ground arrivals.
Basalt top caps and vertical faces have different values, violating the literal neutral-lighting rule.
Several cliff runs repeat upright, similarly capped columns and read as a regular palisade rather than fully weathered irregular coast.
openRisks: The model repainted outside the flat-grey authoring regions despite the prompt lock. The pipeline binding may preserve neighbour pixels, but no stitched pipeline output was produced or verified in this task.
The water mask follows the raw generated source and does not hide the failed edge terrain.
Buildable and steep fractions are manual screen-space estimates rather than surveyed terrain geometry.
Exact wet-pixel boundary judgment and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report makes no visual-acceptance claim.
